notes.title: Update 2.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] 16:10 resolutions are now supported.
[*] Graphics options are no longer synced over Steam Cloud (for better support with Steam Deck).
[*] Text in the achievements app should now be much more readable.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2.0.1
notes.content:
[b]Rosas are Red[/b]
- Added a way to turn off notification sounds.
- Fixed master route CGs not displaying the correct bodywriting.
- Fixed the catgame sometimes getting stuck if a timeskip happens.
- Fixed the 100% gallery achievement not unlocking.
- Fixed the master finale skipping if you select a certain combination of choices.

[b]Bonus Content[/b]
- Added a cut beach CG with Rosa and Mia to the Art Pack.
- Added a Voice Pack containing all the voice messages in the game.
- Added a Lunar New Year chibi of Rosa to the Art Pack.
- Fixed the bodywriting CGs all being the same variant.
